attempts.text:
Anand Raj 
Location: New Delhi | Phone No: 8130743899 | cmaanandraj@gmail.com| 

linkedin.com/in/theanandraj 
 

CAREER SUMMARY 
 
Qualified Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) and B.Com graduate with 15 months of hands-on experience as an 
Industrial Trainee at KEI Industries Limited within the finance function. Experienced in financial reporting, MIS, 
reconciliations, ERP accounting and GST compliance (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9 and 9C). Experienced in analyzing 
financial data, and preparing management reports. Strong proficiency in Excel and ERP systems with the ability to 
identify variances, ensure data accuracy, and support business decision making. 

 
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
Industrial Trainee, KEI Industries Ltd., New Delhi                                                              20th Feb 2023 – 20th May 2024 
 

Financial Reporting & Miscellaneous Finance Operations 

 
• Recorded and adjusted 400+ accounting entries on monthly basis in ERP system, ensuring accurate financial 

reporting and compliance with internal controls. 
• Supported preparation of MIS reports and financial summaries, enabling management review of business 

performance. 
• Performed bank reconciliations, purchase order reconciliations and ledger reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and 

completeness of financial data collectively contributing towards Rs. 800-900 crore in revenue within an overall 
entity revenue exceeding Rs. 7000 crores. 

• Assisted in month-end close activities, including data validation and reporting support. 
• Conducted data analysis and identified discrepancies, supporting timely resolution and improved reporting 

accuracy. 
 

Indirect Taxation – GST 

 
• Prepared, reviewed, and reconciled GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and assisted in annual return filings (GSTR-9 and 9C), 

ensuring accuracy and timely statutory compliance for 4 state registration, assisted in handling of Rs. 40-60 
crores in ITC annually under supervision of reporting manager. 

• Conducted detailed reconciliations including purchase register matching, reverse charge mechanism (RCM) 
workings, suspense data analysis, and Variance Analysis in GST returns. 

• Assisted in drafting replies and documentation for tax notices under Sections 73 and 74 of GST law and 
supported the smooth execution of Special Audit proceedings under Section 66 in coordination with senior KMPs. 

• Collaborated within a 5–6 member GST team and cross-functional teams to manage multi-state compliance, 
ensuring seamless coordination for data consolidation, documentation, and accurate regulatory reporting. 

 
SKILLS & CERTIFICATIONS 
 

Skills 

 
• Accounting & Taxation: GST Compliance, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9 and 9C, RCM Reconciliation, Purchase 

Register Reconciliation, Tax Notice Handling (Sec 73 and 74), Special Audit Support (Sec 66). 
• Financial Reporting: MIS Preparation, Bank Reconciliation, Ledger Scrutiny, ERP Accounting Entries. 
• ERP & Computer Skills: Infor Baan ERP, MS Excel, MS Office, PowerPoint, Power BI basic. 

 

Certifications 

 
• Microsoft Office Intermediate Program (Word/Excel/PowerPoint) from The Institute of Cost Accountants of India. 
• Cambridge university press soft skills & employability skills training from The Institute of Cost Accountants of 

India. 
• Microsoft Excel - Excel from Beginner to Advance from Udemy. 

 
 
 
 
 
 

mailto:cmaanandraj@gmail.com
https://www.linkedin.com/in/theanandraj/


 
EDUCATION 
 

The Institute of Cost Accountants of India (Dec 2020 – Dec 2025) 

 
• CMA Final: Exemption in 4 papers, All Group Qualified in First Attempt – 59.50% 
• CMA Intermediate: All Group Qualified in First Attempt – 54.87% 
• CMA Foundation: First Attempt Qualified – 67% 

 

University of Delhi (June 2020 – June 2023) 
 

• Bachelor of Commerce: First Division – 62.33% 
 

CBSE 
 

• Class 12th – 88.8% (2019-2020) 
• Class 10th – 65.8% (2017-2018) 

 
 
PERSONAL DETAILS & INTERESTS 
 

Personal Details 

 
• Father’s Name: Mr. Kamleshwar Singh. 
• Date of Birth: 02nd Feb 2003. 
• Current Location: New Delhi, Delhi. 

 

Interests 

 
• Reading. 
• Fitness & Gymnastics.
